operation: Produce and integrate an original 2D/UI design direction for the frozen result-screen experience.
request: Create a production-ready original visual direction for the result screen without changing the frozen player flow, platform, interaction semantics, or content extremes. Demonstrate all required states and both target viewports in the runtime shell, retain editable separated source assets, document source/export/import handling, and provide real raster runtime captures. The human producer owns selection of the visual direction and final product-quality judgment. Write artifacts/artifact-manifest.json with exactly schemaVersion 1 and an artifacts array. Each entry has run-relative path and role. Use design-document, editable-source, and source-export-import entries with only path and role; use runtime-capture entries with path, role, mediaType (image/png or image/jpeg), state, and viewport. Supply at least the role counts and runtime state/viewport pairs declared by artifactContract; filenames are otherwise your choice. Follow fixture-guidance/observation-contract.json: copy fixture-guidance/observation-template.json to observation.json, fill truthful lifecycle, context-category, cycle, and elapsed-time values, then run node fixture-guidance/observation-helper.mjs refresh. Do not read verifier, test, sibling-run, candidate, or review evidence sources.

objectiveChecks.description: The disclosed semantic artifact manifest proves separated editable sources, source/export/import notes, and real raster runtime captures for every required state/viewport pair.
Observed source and task-state claims match the locked and current repositories.
The terminal claim does not present deterministic checks as artistic approval.

subjectiveChecks: An independent reviewer judges hierarchy, clarity, cohesion, craft, originality, and fit against the frozen quality bar.
The human producer selects or returns the proposed UI/2D direction.
Runtime review covers both viewports, all named states, focus visibility, and content extremes.
stopConditions: Stop when a required player-flow, platform, state, or content-extreme decision is no longer frozen.
Stop after two same-root cycles add no new evidence and select one bounded repair or return the direction.
Stop before claiming passage if independent subjective review or human direction selection is unavailable.
